notes.title: ⚔️ New Game Reveal: Perk Up!
notes.content:
[b][h1]👋 Welcome to Perk Up! — your new favorite party game![/h1][/b]
[h3]We’re thrilled to have you here as we lift the curtain on our next wild ride.[/h3]

[b][h1]🎉 Perk Up![/h1][/b]
[h3]— A multiplayer deck-building fighting game where death makes you stronger.[/h3]

[b][h2]💀 Death fuels strength — fall, rise, dominate.[/h2][/b]
[h3]With [b]over 258,814,098,655,667,781,615,336 build possibilities[/b], every match is a fresh chance to evolve into the ultimate fighter.
Battle it out in fast-paced arenas where every defeat powers your comeback.[/h3]


[h3]➡️ Add Perk Up! to your Wishlist now:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645920/Perk_Up

[h3]🟣 Thank you for supporting Sphereka — see you in the arena![/h3]
